SECTION: 2 — the three identity models, frozen before any pair outcome is read

FROZEN_PHYSICS_THESE_RULES_REST_ON.Y_transport: _diffuse applies NEI = ((1,0),(-1,0),(1,1),(-1,1)) SEQUENTIALLY within one step, each pass moving a binomial subset of the CURRENT occupancy with probability p_hop_Y/4. A particle can therefore be moved by the +y pass and by the +x pass in the same step, but each pass can move it at most once. The net displacement is a sum of a subset of {(+1,0),(-1,0),(0,+1),(0,-1)}, and the +y and -y passes cancel, so the reachable displacement set is exactly {-1,0,1} x {-1,0,1}: the toroidal Moore neighbourhood including self.
FROZEN_PHYSICS_THESE_RULES_REST_ON.WHY_THIS_MATTERS: a rule built on the von Neumann 4-neighbourhood would under-count the admissible sources of a cell's mass and would therefore OVER-claim certainty. The Moore neighbourhood is the conservative and exact kernel.
FROZEN_PHYSICS_THESE_RULES_REST_ON.Y_birth_is_cell_local: _react_core computes pair = nX * nY elementwise and draws births ~ Binomial(min(nSY, free), min(1, kY * nX * nY)) at the SAME cell. A Y birth at cell c requires nY(c) > 0 at react time, which is after the hop. The new Y has an exact single-cell ancestor set, not a neighbourhood.
FROZEN_PHYSICS_THESE_RULES_REST_ON.X_birth_is_cell_local: the same loop produces X from SX with p = min(1, kX * nX * nY), so an accepted local X birth at cell c also requires nY(c) > 0 at react time. Local X production is exactly downstream of the Y occupying that cell.
FROZEN_PHYSICS_THESE_RULES_REST_ON.decay: a Y removal converts Y to WY at its own cell. Occupancy is conserved.
FROZEN_PHYSICS_THESE_RULES_REST_ON.archive_semantics: a cell row for step t is written AFTER the whole step. So the Y mass on row t+1 arrived from cells within Moore-1 on row t, whether it hopped there or was born there from Y that hopped there.

MODEL_A.name: LOCKED_SPATIAL_DAUGHTER
MODEL_A.object: the original daughter component at the admissible fork
MODEL_A.continuation: only under the frozen mutual-unique spatial identity rule at CORE_R: a link survives when the previous centre has exactly one candidate within CORE_R and that candidate has exactly one candidate back
MODEL_A.implementation: already frozen and qualified in OMLDCT02: classifiers A and B agreed on all 33 pairs, both arms, on duration, exposure, termination type, interval end, min and max nY and the full nY histogram. CLEA01 re-uses those values and computes nothing new for Model A.

MODEL_B.name: AMBIENT_POPULATION
MODEL_B.object: all Y-organising components in the world after the intervention
MODEL_B.role: NEGATIVE SPECIFICITY CONTROL. It reproduces the broad object that produced the earlier saturated ambient endpoint. It is NOT an acceptable reproduction object and CLEA01 may not select it.
MODEL_B.continuation: none required — the object is the whole post-intervention Y population, so it persists for as long as any Y exists
MODEL_B.why_it_is_here: a candidate object that cannot be distinguished from B has explained nothing. B is the thing Model C must be shown NOT to be.

MODEL_C.name: DISTRIBUTED_CAUSAL_LINEAGE
MODEL_C.object: a time-directed causal subgraph rooted in the originally locked daughter at the fork
MODEL_C.ROOT: the locked daughter cell set at t_m, taken verbatim from the fork ledger field FORK.locked_daughter_cells. It is a frozen input, identical in both arms by construction, and it is the ONLY seeding information Model C receives.
MODEL_C.STATE: for every step t >= t_m, two sets of Y-occupied cells: CERTAIN(t) and POSSIBLE(t), with CERTAIN(t) a subset of POSSIBLE(t). The bracket IS the set-valued causal relation the launcher requires; no weight, no threshold and no tuned parameter enters anywhere.
MODEL_C.INITIALISATION: CERTAIN(t_m) = POSSIBLE(t_m) = the locked daughter cells at t_m.
MODEL_C.ADMISSIBLE_SOURCE_SET: S(d, t+1) = { c : c is Y-occupied on row t and c lies within toroidal Chebyshev distance 1 of d }. This is the exact reachable-displacement kernel derived above.
MODEL_C.CERTAIN_RULE: d is in CERTAIN(t+1) iff d is Y-occupied on row t+1, S(d, t+1) is non-empty, and every member of S(d, t+1) is in CERTAIN(t). In words: every route by which mass could have reached d came from the lineage.
MODEL_C.POSSIBLE_RULE: d is in POSSIBLE(t+1) iff d is Y-occupied on row t+1 and at least one member of S(d, t+1) is in POSSIBLE(t).
MODEL_C.SPLIT: no special rule. The bracket propagates and may cover several spatially disconnected components at once. A split does not terminate Model C — that is the whole point of the model.
MODEL_C.MERGE: a cell fed by both lineage and non-lineage sources is POSSIBLE but NOT CERTAIN. That is provenance from every contributing branch, expressed as a bracket rather than as an invented genealogy.
MODEL_C.Y_BIRTH_ATTRIBUTION: an accepted Y birth recorded at (t+1, d) is CERTAIN-lineage iff S(d, t+1) is a non-empty subset of CERTAIN(t), and POSSIBLE-lineage iff S(d, t+1) meets POSSIBLE(t). It is judged on the pre-state, never on whether the newborn survived.
MODEL_C.Y_REMOVAL_ATTRIBUTION: identically, on the same pre-state rule. A removal that empties a cell removes it from both sets at the next row, which is what the physics does.
MODEL_C.X_BIRTH_ATTRIBUTION: an accepted local X birth recorded at (t+1, d) is CERTAIN-downstream iff S(d, t+1) is a non-empty subset of CERTAIN(t), POSSIBLE-downstream iff S(d, t+1) meets POSSIBLE(t). Judged on the pre-state so that it does not depend on post-decay occupancy.
MODEL_C.TERMINATION: CERTAIN terminates at the first row where CERTAIN is empty; POSSIBLE at the first row where POSSIBLE is empty. Neither can revive: a cell can only enter a set through a source already in it.
MODEL_C.THE_REPORTED_OBJECT: CERTAIN. POSSIBLE is the uncertainty envelope and is reported on every quantity, always, and is never used to make a claim.
MODEL_C.WHY_THIS_REJECTS_AMBIENT_SUCCESSION: an ambient component that merely comes to occupy a nearby cell has at least one non-lineage admissible source, so it can never be CERTAIN. Occupying a neighbouring cell, or performing the same function, buys nothing.
WHAT_MODEL_C_MAY_NOT_USE: the online selected-daughter ID after the fork
any future survival or exposure outcome
MODEL_C.NO_INVENTED_GENEALOGY: no molecular parent-child relation is asserted anywhere. Where ancestry is not determined by the physics, the bracket widens; it is never resolved by preference.

MACHINE_CHECKABLE_INVARIANT: for every occupied cell d on row t+1 with t+1 > t_m, S(d, t+1) must be non-empty — Y mass cannot appear where no Moore-1 neighbour held Y on the previous row. Any violation is an archive or kernel error, not a lineage finding, and is reported as such.
FROZEN_BEFORE: any per-pair outcome field beyond the single row already declared in the parent binding, and before the development/validation split is drawn
